// ---- api/applications ----
export interface Application {
    id: number;
    name: string;
    pkg: string;
    version?: string;
    versionCode?: number;
    url?: string;
    apkHash?: string;
    sha256?: string;
    icon?: string;
    iconId?: number;
    type?: string;
    system?: boolean;
    latestVersion?: number;
    runAfterInstall?: boolean;
    hasApkHash?: boolean;
    commonApplication?: boolean;
    deletionProhibited?: boolean;
    parts?: string;
}

// ---- api/client ----
export declare const API_BASE: string;
export type ResponseStatus = 'OK' | 'ERROR' | string;
export interface ApiEnvelope<T> {
    status: ResponseStatus;
    message: string | null;
    data: T;
}
export declare class ApiError extends Error {
    readonly status: ResponseStatus;
    readonly httpStatus: number;
    readonly data?: unknown;
    constructor(message: string, status: ResponseStatus, httpStatus: number, data?: unknown);
}
export declare const apiClient: {
    get: <T>(path: string, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>;
    post: <T>(path: string, body?: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>;
    postText: <T>(path: string, body: string, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>;
    put: <T>(path: string, body?: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>;
    del: <T>(path: string, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>;
    postForm: <T>(path: string, form: FormData, signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>;
};

// ---- api/commands ----
export interface QueueCommandRequest {
    type: string;
    requiresCapability?: string;
    payload?: string;
}
export interface DeviceState {
    battery: number;
    charging: boolean;
    locked: boolean;
    kioskActive: boolean;
    androidRelease: string;
    lastBootAt: number;
    updatedAt: number;
    agentVersion?: string | null;
    powerMode?: string | null;
    appliedConfigRevision?: string | null;
}

// ---- api/configSync ----
export interface ConfigStatus {
    configurationId?: number | null;
    currentRevision?: string | null;
    appliedRevision?: string | null;
    appliedAt?: number | null;
    inSync: boolean;
    supported: boolean;
    lastCommand?: {
        id: number;
        status: string;
        detail?: string | null;
        createdAt?: number;
        completedAt?: number;
    } | null;
}

// ---- api/configurations ----
export interface ConfigApp {
    id: number;
    applicationId?: number;
    name?: string;
    pkg?: string;
    version?: string;
    action?: number;
    showIcon?: boolean;
    remove?: boolean;
    system?: boolean;
    usedVersionId?: number;
    screenOrder?: number | null;
    keyCode?: number | null;
    bottom?: boolean | null;
    longTap?: boolean | null;
}
export interface Configuration {
    id?: number;
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    qrCodeKey?: string;
    applications?: ConfigApp[];
    extensions?: Record<string, unknown>;
    [key: string]: unknown;
}

    hardwareId?: string;
    custom1?: string;
    custom2?: string;
    custom3?: string;
    oldNumber?: string;
    launcherPkg?: string;
    groups?: {
        id: number;
        name: string;
    }[];
}

// ---- ext/types ----
export declare const EXTENSION_API_VERSION = 1;
export type LazyComponent<P = object> = LazyExoticComponent<ComponentType<P>>;
export interface Requirement {
    permission?: string | readonly string[];
    serverPlugin?: string;
    when?: (ctx: {
        user: CurrentUser;
    }) => boolean;
}
export interface CurrentUser {
    id: number;
    login: string;
    name?: string;
    email?: string;
    superAdmin: boolean;
    allDevices: boolean;
    permissions: readonly string[];
}
interface Base {
    id: string;
    requires?: Requirement;
}
interface Ordered extends Base {
    order: number;
}
export interface NavItemContribution extends Ordered {
    slot: 'nav.item';
    label: string;
    icon: ComponentType<IconProps>;
    to: string;
    badge?: ComponentType;
}
export interface RoutePageContribution extends Base {
    slot: 'route.page';
    path: string;
    component: LazyComponent;
}
export type DeviceCommand = {
    label: string;
    request: QueueCommandRequest;
} | {
    label: string;
    build(values: Record<string, string>): QueueCommandRequest;
};
export interface DeviceContextValue {
    device: DeviceView;
    telemetry: TelemetrySnapshot | null;
    telemetryLoaded: boolean;
    state: DeviceState | null;
    configuration: Configuration | null;
    configStatus: ConfigStatus | null;
    now: number;
    refresh(): void;
    sendCommand(command: DeviceCommand, values?: Record<string, string>): Promise<boolean>;
}
export interface DeviceTabContribution extends Ordered {
    slot: 'device.tab';
    label: string;
    icon?: ComponentType<IconProps>;
    component: LazyComponent;
    count?(device: DeviceContextValue): string | undefined;
}
export interface DeviceRailGroupContribution extends Ordered {
    slot: 'device.railGroup';
    title: string;
    items(device: DeviceContextValue): KeyValueItem[];
}
export interface ConfigSectionProps<T> {
    value: T;
    stored: T;
    onChange(next: T): void;
    readOnly: boolean;
    configuration: Readonly<Configuration>;
    errors: readonly string[];
    idBase: string;
}
export interface ConfigSectionContribution<T> extends Ordered {
    slot: 'config.section';
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    storage: {
        namespace?: string;
        defaults: T;
    };
    component: LazyComponent<ConfigSectionProps<T>>;
    validate?(value: T, configuration: Readonly<Configuration>): string[];
    changes?(stored: T, value: T): number;
}
export interface SettingsSectionProps {
    anchorId: string;
    headingId: string;
}
export interface SettingsSectionContribution extends Ordered {
    slot: 'settings.section';
    title: string;
    component: LazyComponent<SettingsSectionProps>;
}
export interface OverviewCardContribution extends Ordered {
    slot: 'overview.card';
    placement: 'main' | 'aside' | 'stat';
    component: LazyComponent;
}
export interface ListRows {
    devices: DeviceView;
    apps: Application;
}
export interface RowActionHelpers {
    toast: ToastApi;
    refresh(): void;
}
export interface DeviceActionHelpers extends RowActionHelpers {
    sendCommand(devices: readonly DeviceView[], command: DeviceCommand, values?: Record<string, string>): Promise<boolean>;
}
export interface ListHelpers {
    devices: DeviceActionHelpers;
    apps: RowActionHelpers;
}
export type ListColumnContribution = {
    [L in keyof ListRows]: Ordered & {
        slot: 'list.column';
        list: L;
        header: string | ReactElement;
        cell(row: ListRows[L]): ReactElement | string | number | null;
        sortValue?(row: ListRows[L]): string | number | null;
        mono?: boolean;
        align?: 'left' | 'right';
    };
}[keyof ListRows];
export type ListRowActionContribution = {
    [L in keyof ListRows]: Ordered & {
        slot: 'list.rowAction';
        list: L;
        item(row: ListRows[L], helpers: ListHelpers[L]): MenuItem | null;
    };
}[keyof ListRows];
export interface ListBulkActionContribution extends Ordered {
    slot: 'list.bulkAction';
    list: 'devices';
    label: string;
    icon?: ReactElement;
    danger?: boolean;
    run(rows: readonly DeviceView[], helpers: DeviceActionHelpers): void | Promise<void>;
}
export type Contribution = NavItemContribution | RoutePageContribution | DeviceTabContribution | DeviceRailGroupContribution | ConfigSectionContribution<any> | SettingsSectionContribution | OverviewCardContribution | ListColumnContribution | ListRowActionContribution | ListBulkActionContribution;
export interface ExtensionDefinition {
    id: string;
    apiVersion: typeof EXTENSION_API_VERSION;
    title: string;
    requires?: Requirement;
    contributions: readonly Contribution[];
}
export declare function defineExtension(definition: ExtensionDefinition): ExtensionDefinition;
export declare function configSection<T>(section: Omit<ConfigSectionContribution<T>, 'slot'>): ConfigSectionContribution<T>;
export declare function lazyComponent<P, K extends string>(load: () => Promise<Record<K, ComponentType<P>>>, name: K): LazyComponent<P>;

// ---- ui/Button ----
export type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'subtle' | 'ghost';
export type ButtonSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'hero' | 'auth';
interface CommonProps {
    variant?: ButtonVariant;
    size?: ButtonSize;
    icon?: ReactNode;
    iconEnd?: ReactNode;
    strong?: boolean;
    block?: boolean;
}
export type ButtonProps = CommonProps & ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>;
export declare const Button: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<CommonProps & ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
export type ButtonLinkProps = CommonProps & LinkProps;
export declare function ButtonLink({ variant, size, icon, iconEnd, strong, block, className, children, ...rest }: ButtonLinkProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type ButtonAnchorProps = CommonProps & AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>;
export declare function ButtonAnchor({ variant, size, icon, iconEnd, strong, block, className, children, ...rest }: ButtonAnchorProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export type IconButtonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
export interface IconButtonProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'aria-label'> {
    label: string;
    size?: IconButtonSize;
    tone?: 'default' | 'strong';
    children: ReactNode;
}
export declare const IconButton: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<IconButtonProps & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
export interface LinkButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
    tone?: 'strong' | 'quiet' | 'inline';
}
export declare const LinkButton: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<LinkButtonProps & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;

    subtitle?: ReactNode;

    titleAdornment?: ReactNode;
    breadcrumb?: ReactNode;
    docTitle?: string;
    subtitleMaxCh?: number;
    actionsGap?: 8 | 12;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function PageHeader({ title, subtitle, actions, titleAdornment, breadcrumb, docTitle, subtitleMaxCh, actionsGap, className, }: PageHeaderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export interface Crumb {
    label: ReactNode;
    to?: string;
    mono?: boolean;
}
export declare function Breadcrumb({ items, className }: {
    items: ReadonlyArray<Crumb>;
    className?: string;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;

    noun?: string;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function Pagination({ page, pageSize, total, onPageChange, pageSizeOptions, onPageSizeChange, suffix, variant, noun, className, }: PaginationProps): import("react").JSX.Element;

// ---- ui/Segmented ----
export type SegmentValue = string | number | boolean | null;
export interface SegmentOption<V extends SegmentValue> {
    value: V;
    label: ReactNode;
    icon?: ReactNode;
    count?: ReactNode;
    disabled?: boolean;
    ariaLabel?: string;
}
export type SegmentedSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
export interface SegmentedProps<V extends SegmentValue> {
    options: ReadonlyArray<SegmentOption<V>>;
    value: V | undefined;
    onChange: (value: V) => void;
    size?: SegmentedSize;
    'aria-label'?: string;
    'aria-labelledby'?: string;
    'aria-describedby'?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    wrap?: boolean;
    className?: string;
    id?: string;
}
export declare function Segmented<V extends SegmentValue>({ options, value, onChange, size, disabled, wrap, className, id, ...aria }: SegmentedProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element;
export interface PolicySegment {
    value: boolean | null;
    label: string;
}
export interface TriStateProps {
    value: boolean | null | undefined;
    onChange: (value: boolean | null) => void;
    segments?: ReadonlyArray<PolicySegment>;
    size?: SegmentedSize;
    disabled?: boolean;
    'aria-label'?: string;
    'aria-labelledby'?: string;
    'aria-describedby'?: string;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function TriState({ segments, ...rest }: TriStateProps): import("react").JSX.Element;

// ---- ui/Status ----
export type StatusTone = 'ok' | 'warn' | 'alert' | 'idle';
export type StatusShape = 'circle' | 'diamond' | 'square' | 'ring';
export type StatusKind = 'online' | 'attention' | 'offline' | 'inSync' | 'applying' | 'applyFailed' | 'agentTooOld' | 'notReported' | 'noConfiguration' | 'applied' | 'failed' | 'notSupported' | 'done' | 'pending' | 'expired';
export interface StatusDotProps {
    tone: StatusTone;
    shape?: StatusShape;
    size?: 6 | 7 | 8;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function StatusDot({ tone, shape, size, className }: StatusDotProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export interface StatusPillProps {
    status: StatusKind;
    label?: ReactNode;
    dot?: boolean;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function StatusPill({ status, label, dot, className }: StatusPillProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export interface StatusTextProps {
    status?: StatusKind;
    tone?: StatusTone;
    shape?: StatusShape;
    variant?: 'sync' | 'reason' | 'meta';
    children?: ReactNode;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function StatusText({ status, tone, shape, variant, children, className }: StatusTextProps): import("react").JSX.Element;

// ---- ui/Table ----
export interface Column<Row> {
    key: string;
    header: ReactNode;
    headerHidden?: boolean;
    cell: (row: Row) => ReactNode;
    shrink?: boolean;
    align?: 'left' | 'right';
    mono?: boolean;
    sortable?: boolean;
    className?: string;
}
export type SortDir = 'ascending' | 'descending';
export interface TableProps<Row> {
    columns: ReadonlyArray<Column<Row>>;
    rows: ReadonlyArray<Row>;
    rowKey: (row: Row) => Key;
    'aria-label'?: string;
    edge?: 0 | 16 | 20 | 24;
    minWidth?: number;
    headless?: boolean;
    rowPad?: 10 | 12;
    selection?: {
        selected: ReadonlySet<Key>;
        onToggle: (key: Key, row: Row) => void;
        onToggleAll: (select: boolean) => void;
        rowLabel: (row: Row) => string;
        allLabel?: string;
    };
    sort?: {
        key: string;
        dir: SortDir;
        onSort: (key: string) => void;
    };
    empty?: ReactNode;
    onRowClick?: (row: Row) => void;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function Table<Row>({ columns, rows, rowKey, edge, minWidth, headless, rowPad, selection, sort, empty, onRowClick, className, ...aria }: TableProps<Row>): import("react").JSX.Element;

// ---- ui/Tabs ----
export interface TabItem<K extends string> {
    key: K;
    label: ReactNode;
    icon?: ReactNode;
    count?: ReactNode;
    disabled?: boolean;
}
export type TabsSize = 'tab' | 'lg' | 'md';
export type TabChange = 'click' | 'keyboard';
export interface TabsProps<K extends string> {
    items: ReadonlyArray<TabItem<K>>;
    value: K;
    onChange: (key: K, via: TabChange) => void;
    'aria-label': string;
    size?: TabsSize;
    idBase?: string;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function Tabs<K extends string>({ items, value, onChange, idBase, size, className, ...aria }: TabsProps<K>): import("react").JSX.Element;
export interface TabPanelProps {
    idBase: string;
    tabKey: string;
    children: ReactNode;
    className?: string;
}
export declare function TabPanel({ idBase, tabKey, children, className }: TabPanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export interface LinkTabItem {
    key: string;
    to: string;
    label: ReactNode;
    icon?: ReactNode;
    count?: ReactNode;
    active?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    badge?: ReactNode;
}
export declare function LinkTabs({ items, size, className, 'aria-label': ariaLabel, }: {
    items: ReadonlyArray<LinkTabItem>;
    size?: TabsSize;
    'aria-label': string;
    className?: string;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;

// ---- ui/Toggle ----
export interface ToggleProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'onChange' | 'role' | 'aria-checked' | 'value'> {
    checked: boolean;
    onChange: (checked: boolean) => void;
    showState?: boolean;
    stateLabels?: [on: string, off: string];
}
export declare const Toggle: import("react").ForwardRefExoticComponent<ToggleProps & import("react").RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>;
